baseline.observation: The immutable native release contract is present, but its current candidate still carries the embedded Evolution source. It cannot be copied to a new repository until the candidate accepts a separately pinned upstream artifact.

ownership.crmRole: consumer of the versioned adapter contract and proxy owner
ownership.engineRole: one externally pinned Evolution API runtime; it is not source owned by skincos-whatsapp-adapter
ownership.platformRole: native-host lifecycle and global coordination remain Platform/Ops owned until a signed cross-repository custody interface exists

custodyReleaseBaseline.requiredRewrite: The future repository must obtain the Evolution implementation as an independently pinned immutable upstream artifact. It must not require messaging/channels/whatsapp/engine in its source archive, working tree or release candidate.
requiredReleaseFacts: only release-source-<SHA> candidates are release inputs
promotion requires an installed attested predecessor
external authenticated custody binds workflow run, artifact identity and source-archive digest before apply
rollback restarts messaging-whatsapp.service and verifies http://127.0.0.1:8080/health

crmOnlyState.rule: Conversation annotations, reactions, flags and media metadata remain CRM-owned and are not migrated into the adapter or engine runtime.

prohibited: a second systemd unit or process manager for Evolution
a checkout or worktree runtime root
adapter ownership of CRM conversation metadata

requiredBeforeRepositoryCreation: package the direct adapter closure with an exact private version for CRM
replace the embedded engine source input with a pinned external upstream artifact and digest
define the signed Platform/Ops custody interface without copying global coordinator code
prove a single publisher, single service unit, preview or staging smoke and executable rollback
cutoverGate.currentAction: No repository creation, deploy, service mutation, secret provisioning or state migration is permitted by this boundary.
